mapper.sql: p.personal_place_id, p.user_id, p.name, p.category, p.road_address, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, COALESCE(u.login_id, p.user_id::text) AS login_id, p.memo, p.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM personal_places p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM personal_places p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.personal_place_id = #{personalPlaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_places (user_id, name, category, road_address, address, latitude, longitude, source, memo, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{roadAddress}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{source}, #{memo}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE personal_places SET name = #{name}, category = #{category}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = now() WHERE personal_place_id = #{personalPlaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM personal_places WHERE personal_place_id = #{personalPlaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
